statusNote: contracts verified live on Sepolia (TRACE 2026-09-26); ABIs from ensdomains/contracts-v2@71a3b733

protects: human-readable binding of a name to records chosen by the name's controller
verifies: record values are what the resolver returns for the current name owner/manager
requiresTrustIn: name owner and delegated record managers
the RPC used to read it
doesNotProtectAgainst: a compromised name owner rewriting records
financial misuse — ENS grants no financial authority

limitations: ENSv2 is beta on Sepolia; ENSIP-25/26 are draft standards
ENSv1 cannot mint new names on Sepolia (controller de-authorised)
registration: commit-reveal (>=60 s), >=28 days, 5+ chars = 8 USDC/yr paid in ENSv2 MockUSDC — not Aave test USDC
records use setText(bytes dnsName, key, value); a scoped setter can write that key on every name the resolver serves, so each agent gets its own resolver
subnames need a UserRegistry proxy per parent (setSubregistry → setParent → register)
